about.headline: Strategy at 24 frames per second.
about.p1: I'm a Communication Social student at Universidad Monteávila and Content Strategist at EGCars, where I'm helping launch Suzuki in Venezuela. My work sits at the intersection of cinema, brand, and emerging AI tooling — I treat content strategy the way a director treats a film: every frame earns its place.
about.p2: When I'm not writing campaigns, I'm directing music videos, shooting street-journalism in Caracas, or analyzing how franchises like Nolan's build loyal audiences.
about.fact: B.A. Communication Social · GPA 17.00 / 20.00 · Cambridge B2
